sources.snippet: The model Cyber-focused uncensored build of Qwen3.8-27B: Heretic KL-optimized abliteration plus a gentle partial-strength Arditi peel of the hardest build-working-malware refusal direction; vision and MTP left untouched. The author reports cyber/offensive-security openness 99/100 on their eval set and GSM8K 22/25 with a full thinking budget. Full recipe on the base model card.
